messages:
maya: Heads up — I just got a DM from someone claiming to be 'Alan @acme-vendor'. They asked me to approve an SSO app called 'acm-ci-deploy' so CI can access KMS to decrypt secrets. Sent link: https://acme-review.example/login?app=acm-ci-deploy

maya: I clicked the link but didn't enter creds. It asked to 'Authorize app to access: Google Cloud KMS (decrypt)'.

sec-bot: alert: external_dm_impersonation detected for user maya — flagged by ai-phish-detector v2

samir (sec-oncall): @maya — thanks. Please don't interact with the page further. Can you screenshot the DM and paste the exact message text?

maya: Screenshot uploaded. DM text:
> "Hey Maya, Alan from Acme here. Quick favor — approve our SSO app so CI can pull secrets. It's blocked by a tenant policy, click this link to bypass: https://acme-review.example/login?app=acm-ci-deploy"

jonathan (infra): Did the app show up under Admin Console -> Applications? @maya any admin approval popups?

maya: No admin popup, only the oauth consent-looking modal. I didn't approve anything. Browser history has the acme-review URL.

samir (sec-oncall): Good. @jonathan can you query identity audit logs for any 'app_approval' events for maya in the last 2 hours?

jonathan (infra): Running: ```bash
curl -s "https://idp.internal/api/audit?user=maya&event=app_approval&since=1972020000" | jq '.events[] | {ts,message,actor}'
``` Will paste results.

jonathan (infra): Result: no app_approval events. There is a 'oauth_consent_attempt' from IP 52.14.98.211 to app acm-ci-deploy at 1972023340

samir (sec-oncall): Good. No grant was issued. Still treat as phishing. @security_ops can we sandbox the URL and check for token collection behavior?

security_ops: Submitted URL to sandbox. Verdict: no binary payload, but page contains JS that POSTs a bearer token to `https://collector.acme-review.example/api/collect` if consent is completed. Also checks for `window.opener` to steal OAuth callback.

security_ops: IOC: collector.acme-review.example, IP 52.14.98.211

samir (sec-oncall): Containment: 1) Block collector.acme-review.example at perimeter and WAF 2) Revoke any recent OAuth grants to external apps (just in case) 3) Rotate any service account keys that ci-deploy had access to 4) Disable external DMs for non-admins temporarily. @infra please start firewall rule and KMS audit.

jonathan (infra): Firewall rule pushed. `ufw deny out to 52.14.98.211` (internal proxy rule). Also asked GCP KMS team for usage logs. Command used: ```bash
gcloud kms keys versions list --keyring=prod --key=ci-secrets --project=redwood --filter=\"createTime>1972020000\"
```

jonathan (infra): KMS usage: no decrypt calls from maya or acm-ci-deploy service accounts in window. Last decrypts were from known-runner@ci at 1972019000.

samir (sec-oncall): Ok no signs of secret exfil. Post-incident actions: - Create phish verdict and IOC block - Notify SSO admins to require org-owned app publisher verification for admin-level scopes - Run org search for other messages from collector.acme-review.example - Awareness email to Eng with example DM and do/don't list

maya: Thanks — can I delete the DM thread? Also should I rotate my personal access tokens? I didn't enter creds.

samir (sec-oncall): You can delete. Rotate only if you suspect creds entered. But rotate sessions if you approved any unknown apps. We'll send org-wide guidance anyway.

sec-bot: action logged: incident 2026-03-20-impersonation-1972023456 created; severity: low-med; assigned: samir, jonathan, security_ops

samir (sec-oncall): Follow-up items assigned: (1) infra - block IOC and run org-wide DNS/URL search (2) devex - update onboarding docs about untrusted app approvals (3) comms - draft awareness message by EOD

ella (comms): Draft ready, will share in #announcements and email to all. Suggested subject: "Security: suspicious SSO app impersonation via external DM — what to do" :warning:

samir (sec-oncall): Closing note: no compromise detected, containment done, awareness + policy changes in flight. Will follow up in 24h with final RCA.

maya: Thanks team :heart:
